meta.rule: Every row links an official page or PDF. Unprinted fields stay null and are listed on the Flagged for Review page.
meta.separate_section: Anything with re-entry, rebuy or an add-on is catalogued in 'advantage_by_spending'. Those rows are described, not disqualified.

events.venue_full: Wynn Las Vegas — Poker Room, Encore
events.name: Daily NLH $200 — $10,000 guarantee

fee.fee_breakdown: $26 tournament fee + $12 poker staff service charge

events.late_reg: Until the start of level 9 (approximately 4:30 p.m.)
events.reentry: YES — the terms call out the re-entry fee and say registration and re-entries run to level 9
events.note: Suspended during Signature/Millions/Classic series. The WPT World Championship runs Nov 27 – Dec 21, 2026, so confirm the daily is running before relying on it.

events.venue_full: Wynn Las Vegas — Poker Room, Encore
events.name: Friday NLH Rebuy & Add-on $240 — $40,000 guarantee
events.late_reg: Until the start of level 9 (approximately 4:30 p.m.)
events.addon: YES — unlimited $200 rebuys for 25,000 chips while at 15,000 chips or fewer, plus one $100 add-on for 15,000 chips until the end of registration
events.note: No re-entry, but rebuys and an add-on are allowed — this belongs in the separate section even though re-entry is barred.

events.venue_full: Wynn Las Vegas — Poker Room, Encore
events.name: Weekend NLH $200 — $25,000 guarantee

fee.fee_breakdown: $26 tournament fee + $12 poker staff service charge

events.late_reg: Until the start of level 9 (approximately 4:30 p.m.)
events.reentry: YES — the terms call out the re-entry fee and state that re-entries run to level 9

events.venue_full: Wynn Las Vegas — Poker Room, Encore
events.name: Nightly NLH $160 — $10,000 guarantee
events.note: Named on the official poster and poker page, but the structures PDF read here prints terms only for the Mon–Thu, Friday and weekend events. Fee, chips, level minutes and entry rules were not published there, so they are blank.

events.venue_full: Bellagio — Poker Room, north side of casino next to the sportsbook
events.name: NLH $600

fee.fee_breakdown: $50 house fee, plus a $40 voluntary staff gratuity that adds 15,000 chips

events.late_reg: Through the end of level 8 (including the break)
events.reentry: YES — 'Players may buy-in and re-enter through the end of level 8 (Including Break)'
events.addon: YES in effect — $40 voluntary staff gratuity at registration buys 15,000 extra chips (15,000 + 15,000)
events.note: No guarantee printed on the Friday sheet.

events.name: NLH $1,100 (sheet heading; linked file name says $1,000)
events.guarantee_note: Rule 08 guarantees the 'total Combined Prize Pool' of at least $50,000 — a combined multi-flight figure, not a per-flight guarantee.
events.late_reg: Until the start of level 10 (approx. 5:15 p.m. for flights 1A/1B, 4:15 p.m. 1C, 9:30 p.m. 1D)
events.addon: YES in effect — $40 voluntary staff gratuity adds 20,000 chips
events.irregularity: The linked PDF contradicts itself: filename '$1000 NLH', heading 'NLH $1100 BUY-IN', and rule 07 splits 'the $600 Buy-in'. The buy-in cannot be confirmed from this document.

wpt_meta.source: W_WPT (official Wynn poster, Nov 27 – Dec 21, 2026), both poster pages transcribed in full
wpt_meta.fee_note: The poster defers fees to the per-event structure sheets; those were not read in this session, so every WPT fee is blank and flagged.
wpt_meta.championship_rule: W_WPT_PR: the $10,400 WPT World Championship allows 'a single entry per starting flight' — with three flights that still permits up to three entries in the event overall.

advantage_by_spending.name: Daily NLH $100
advantage_by_spending.late_reg: Registration closes at the start of level 7; sign-ups open one hour before the event
advantage_by_spending.reentry: YES — 'may re-enter, by paying the entry fee, upon elimination within the first break of play'
advantage_by_spending.addon: YES — $50 add-on for 15,000 chips, first break only
advantage_by_spending.why: Re-entry and an add-on both let a player pay more for more chips.

advantage_by_spending.name: Daily NLH $160

advantage_by_spending.why: Re-entry and an add-on both let a player pay more for more chips.

advantage_by_spending.name: Friday NLH Rebuy & Add-on $240
advantage_by_spending.why: Rebuys and an add-on are the spend-for-chips pattern the user asked to separate. This is the one case where 'no re-entry' and 'no spending advantage' disagree.

advantage_by_spending.name: Bellagio Friday $600 — optional staff-gratuity chip bonus
advantage_by_spending.why: A registration payment that increases the starting stack functions as an add-on.
